A '''wooden sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword]] of the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] tier, crafted from two planks and a stick. It keeps vanilla's {{Hp|4}} damage but lasts {{Value|Wooden Sword|durability}} hits instead of 59.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Wooden Sword|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Wooden Sword|attackspeed}}. A [[copper sword]] adds one more point of damage.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with planks. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
